package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type onboardingRepositoryStub struct {
	item  domain.StudentOnboarding
	err   error
	saved domain.StudentOnboarding
}

func (stub *onboardingRepositoryStub) Get(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	return stub.item, stub.err
}

func (stub *onboardingRepositoryStub) Save(_ context.Context, item domain.StudentOnboarding, _ int64) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	stub.saved = item
	return item, nil
}

type onboardingClockStub struct{ now time.Time }

func (stub onboardingClockStub) Now() time.Time { return stub.now }

func TestPutStudentOnboardingCreatesVersionedInitialHypothesis(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &onboardingRepositoryStub{err: domain.ErrNotFound}
	useCase := PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}

	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), PutStudentOnboardingInput{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", ExpectedVersion: 0,
		DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic",
		DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job",
		PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("put onboarding: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Version != 1 || result.CreatedAt != now || result.UpdatedAt != now {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected version metadata: %+v", result)
	}
	if repository.saved.SelfAssessedExperience != "basic" {
		t.Fatalf("self assessment was not persisted: %+v", repository.saved)
	}
}

func TestPutStudentOnboardingRejectsStaleVersion(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &onboardingRepositoryStub{item: domain.StudentOnboarding{Version: 2}}
	useCase := PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}
	_, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), PutStudentOnboardingInput{
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", ExpectedVersion: 1,
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}
